statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Recently observed Nasdaq/NQ downside persistence remains supported by broad technology weakness, while incomplete direct live NQ pullback detail limits Tail below the high band.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES; the elevated Tail band reflects persistent downside structure and confirming technology weakness, with higher-band escalation requiring clearer current evidence of failed retracements or renewed extension.
headline: Elevated Tail persists into the U.S. afternoon as technology weakness remains broad.
body: Recently observed Nasdaq/NQ weakness remains directionally consistent with fresh supplementary breadth: technology was down 1.12%, semiconductors 2.19%, six of eight tracked megacaps were negative, and all seven tracked semiconductor names were negative. Direct live NQ retracement detail remains incomplete, capping Tail below high.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail was mostly low before moving to WATCH at 14:00 UTC and elevated at 15:00–17:00 UTC as the U.S. rates-led technology decline persisted.
outlookSummary: Tail remains elevated into the remaining U.S. session because the downside regime has persisted and technology breadth is still broadly weak. A durable two-way retracement would reduce Tail; renewed extension with failed pullbacks would sustain or raise it. Tomorrow's event cluster raises Stress first, with Tail conditional on the observed path.

forecast.analysis: Downside Tail remains elevated: the prior hour showed persistent weakness, while fresh supplementary breadth still leans sharply negative. Direct live NQ retracement quality remains incomplete, limiting escalation into the high band.
drivers: Fresh supplementary breadth remains technology-heavy to the downside
Direct live NQ pullback quality remains incomplete

forecast.analysis: Tail stays elevated only if power-hour selling retests or breaks lows with shallow or failed retracements. A durable rebound or materially softer yields would weaken the one-way-path case.
WATCH into the cash close is conditional on residual directional pressure. Two-way closing-auction trade would favor normalization; renewed one-way extension would keep Tail above the low band.
Post-close Tail falls to low if futures rotate and the rates impulse stops intensifying. Continued extension without meaningful retracement would invalidate that baseline.
drivers: Rates impulse after the cash close

forecast.analysis: Low Tail is the base case if early evening trade becomes balanced. A fresh geopolitical or rates shock would need current directional confirmation before materially lifting Tail.
Low Tail persists if futures remain two-way into the overnight transition. Thin liquidity alone does not establish a pathological directional path.
Overnight conditions remain low Tail if price discovery rotates rather than extends. Any renewed directional move would require fresh evidence of failed retracements to justify escalation.
Low Tail remains the baseline in the quiet overnight window. A one-way move would need simultaneous price-path and cross-asset confirmation rather than event risk alone.
Tail remains low unless a new catalyst produces directional efficiency and weak mean reversion. Normal overnight variance alone would not change the policy band.
Low Tail continues if Asian-hours trade stays balanced. A renewed yield or oil shock would matter only if NQ also develops persistent extension.
Tail edges higher only conditionally into the Europe handoff, where thinner liquidity can amplify moves. Persistent NQ extension would still need direct confirmation.
Early-Europe risk remains modest unless cross-asset pressure and NQ direction align. Conflicting signals would primarily keep Stress elevated rather than Tail.
Tail remains low as European liquidity deepens unless yields and technology risk reconnect with persistent NQ direction. Evidence of two-way trade would favor stability.
Conditional Tail stays low-to-watch as the U.S. session approaches. A coherent overnight trend with shallow pullbacks would be the main reason to re-rate higher.
Tail remains low before the U.S. data window unless overnight structure already shows repeated extension. Scheduled releases alone do not constitute pathological-path evidence.
Tail is near the top of the low band as U.S. liquidity approaches. The next move depends on whether premarket price discovery is balanced or persistently directional.
Low Tail persists if premarket trade is two-way. A strong directional move would require failed or shallow retracements before Tail moves into a blocking band.
Event-related Stress rises ahead of the 08:30 ET releases, but Tail stays low absent an already-observed one-way path. The release reaction becomes the key conditional checkpoint.
WATCH is conditional around the 08:30 ET releases and 08:50 ET Fed remarks. Tail rises only if the actual reaction develops persistent direction with weak mean reversion.
drivers: Initial jobless claims and BEA releases at 08:30 ET
Cleveland Fed President Hammack remarks at 08:50 ET

forecast.analysis: Elevated Tail around the cash open is conditional on post-data direction carrying through the opening auction with shallow or failed retracements. A two-way open would argue for a lower band.
Tail remains conditionally elevated through the 10:00 ET housing release only if the opening move extends repeatedly. The housing release itself does not establish a one-way path.
Tail stays at the elevated threshold only if post-data price discovery remains directional with weak pullbacks. Stabilizing yields or a durable technology rebound would lower it.
WATCH becomes the base case if the morning move loses directional efficiency. Renewed extension near session extremes would be the main upside risk to Tail.
WATCH persists into early afternoon only if residual directional pressure remains. Broad two-way trade would continue the normalization path.

forecastDetail.comment: Current Tail remains elevated on recently observed downside persistence and negative technology breadth, but incomplete live NQ pullback detail caps escalation.

Post-close Tail falls to low if futures rebalance and rates stop intensifying; renewed extension would invalidate that baseline.

Overnight Tail stays low if futures remain two-way; thin liquidity alone is not treated as pathological structure.
